title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E4, GIGA
thread:
**Issue #3546 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3546: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E4, GIGA
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds **GIGA**: a permanent two lanes wide in both rows, in both lanes for every rule that reads a lane, and the mark that makes a card GIGA from the hand or on embiggen.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP2, SP3, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## The designer's words

```text
* **GIGA**
  * **GIGA** applies to permanents. They make them 2x2 (visually and actually) taking up two backrow and two unit lanes. It can be applied to traps field spells and units. It is technically part of both lanes basically making it twice as susceptible to cleave and can be lane eated in anything else.
  * You have a lot of freedom to design this but the main thing is that they are supposed to be BIG.
```

## The build (defaults from SP3; change one only with a ruling note)

- A GIGA permanent takes two adjacent lanes in both the unit row and the backrow, four zones. The player picks its left lane as they play it. **Default:** it can be played or summoned only where all four zones are free (or are made free by its own placement rules, as Crater does). When it can't fit, a summon fails and a play is not offered.
- It is in both lanes for every rule that reads a lane: attacks across, Cleave, lane effects, "this lane and adjacent", and later E7's Black Hole and slashed board. An effect that hits each lane once hits it once per lane. A Unit's own attack is made once.
- Making a card GIGA is a mark that carries from the hand onto the field ("Make a permanent in your hand GIGA", "Draw … and make them GIGA"). "Embiggen: GIGA" means the card becomes GIGA when embiggened.

## The cards that will use it

S08 (#106 Spectre, the four Walls, #23 GIGA-ify, #99 Big Time Recruits, #100 Plesiosize), S10 (#56 Impact Reactor), S11 (#52, #53 the drills), S24 (Call to Chaos), and later E7's Black Hole and slashed board.

## The client

The board's layout draws a GIGA permanent across its four zones (`apps/web`, `Game.tsx`'s layers: one owning module each), and drag-to-play offers only the left lanes where it fits. Add a web unit test, and a screenshot in a comment on this issue (the `ui-walkthrough` skill).

## Done when

- [ ] The mechanic is written into the spec's sections it changes (§3, §4, §6, §10), with ruling notes numbered in this issue's block, tests named after them, and the paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- [ ] It is proved on fixture scripts in `crates/engine/tests/rules*` (the `testkit` feature's `scenario()`), with no card yet: the cards come in their own parts.
- [ ] The view (`view_for`) and the wire carry what it shows (`docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` for any boundary it adds; `cargo test … --features jackioh-engine/ts` rewrites `apps/web/src/wire/`), and the client renders it.
- [ ] Every prompt it opens is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout. Every number is a named constant in `crates/engine/src/config.rs` (rule 9). The engine stays pure (rule 4).
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` and `pnpm --dir apps/web test` pass.
- [ ] Nothing changes for players: no shipped card reaches it.

Blocked by #3543

Part of #3534.
````
